label: PF Backlog 391
title: EPIC: Backlog SSOT + Work Scheduler + Pluggable Worker Orchestration (doc: PF-Backlog-SSOT-Scheduler-Pluggable-Workers)
body:
Source doc: docs/PF-Backlog-SSOT-Scheduler-Pluggable-Workers-updated.md (§1-§44). Make the canonical backlog the execution SSOT and add an optional, pluggable external-worker scheduler — extending core/backlog.py, core/job_manager.py, core/run_entry.py and existing API/UI, never a second backlog/queue/workflow/identity. Agents stay native; workers are optional external execution resources. Child items = doc §39 phases.

[decision] Decisions: (1) grooming/analysis is an explicit /pf+API action; analyze_mode on entry = on_entry(default) | defer. (2) analysis + revision stored ON the item so pickup = execute. (3) priority initial at entry, refined at grooming; scheduler uses priority_rank->deps->contention->capability->order-as-tiebreak. (4) assignment manual pull first, auto later, one claim+lease path. (5) deliverables write back to backlog on completion (P8A.1). (6) /pf umbrella, /pipeline deprecated alias (delegation to OpenCode).

[update 2026-10-07] Cut-over note: the worker half of this EPIC was rehomed to the external WorkerGrid component and removed from PF by ADR-0002 (Stages 1-2b: BI-PF-0409, BI-PF-0410, BI-PF-0411). PF retains backlog SSOT, grooming, analysis, scheduler eligibility and job_manager queueing; claim pickup = core/scheduler.py::next_eligible, external coordination = workergrid/{service,store}.py (see docs/WORKERGRID-DESIGN.md section 12). Phase items P0-P12 are now linked via epic=BI-PF-0360 (P0-P11 completed; P5-P9/P11 worker layers deleted by the cut-over, successors in WorkerGrid). Remaining: P12 optimization (BI-PF-0374, deferred until WorkerGrid Stage 3); BI-PF-0383 build plug/unplug wontfixed (no in-PF worker subsystem remains).
